description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236 (24/0290)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, owners, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
